dedupe_keys.name: dpmfa eu enm 2000 2020 dynamic probabilistic material flows of engineered nanomaterials from 2000 to 2020 codes

description: Empa researchers and collaborators publish a dynamic probabilistic material-flow model for engineered nanomaterials in the European Union, Norway and Switzerland. The September 2019 Python 3 release represents nano-silver, titanium dioxide, zinc oxide and carbon nanotubes, with annual lifecycle and waste-treatment flows documented for 2000–2020. Parameterised modules and production CSVs support scenario changes. Code is freely available under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; separately deposited result tables use CC BY-SA 4.0. Those tables provide means, standard deviations, quartiles and extrema. The model can simulate accumulation and releases through wastewater, recycling and disposal systems. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this package. Production filenames extend to 2030 despite the documented study window, so the file contents and configured horizon require checking. Input probability assumptions, missing pathways and simulated uncertainty were not independently assessed. Neither code nor output tables were executed or downloaded.
